state.document: A written order from the army commander to the generals of his army.
state.order: Zieten, take the hussars round the oak wood and strike their right; Hülsen will follow once you are engaged.
formations of this army: the Prussian army (General Frederick); also called the King's army, the whole army, the headquarters, my headquarters, the King, the Feldmarschall
Hülsen's advance guard; also called the advance guard
Tresckow's brigade; also called Tresckow's infantry
Manstein's brigade; also called Manstein's grenadiers
Bevern's wing; also called the left wing infantry
Zieten's hussars; also called the hussars
Krosigk's cuirassiers; also called the cuirassiers
Normann's dragoons; also called the dragoons
Frederick's artillery; also called the artillery, the guns

q0_kind.instructions: Consider what the order tells Zieten's hussars; also called the hussars to do (the relevant words: «Zieten, take the hussars round the oak wood and strike their right;»). What kind of action is it?

criteria.hold: hold or stay where it is, keep a position, wait in place
criteria.advance: advance or march forward towards a place, without being told to attack
criteria.attack: attack, assault, storm or clear the enemy out of a place (infantry)
criteria.charge: charge or strike the enemy with cavalry
criteria.screen: screen, cover, watch or protect a flank without closing with the enemy
criteria.bombard: bombard or cannonade the enemy with artillery
criteria.support: follow or support another friendly formation, stay behind it
criteria.move_hq: move the headquarters or the commander himself

criteria.e1_croats_in_chocenice: the enemy: Croats in Chocenice (or a flank or part of it)
criteria.e2_austrian_cavalry_behind_krechor: the enemy: Austrian cavalry behind Křečhoř (or a flank or part of it)
criteria.w1_hulsen_s_advance_guard: our own Hülsen's advance guard; also called the advance guard
criteria.w2_tresckow_s_brigade: our own Tresckow's brigade; also called Tresckow's infantry
criteria.w3_manstein_s_brigade: our own Manstein's brigade; also called Manstein's grenadiers
criteria.w4_bevern_s_wing: our own Bevern's wing; also called the left wing infantry
criteria.w5_zieten_s_hussars: our own Zieten's hussars; also called the hussars
criteria.w6_krosigk_s_cuirassiers: our own Krosigk's cuirassiers; also called the cuirassiers
criteria.w7_normann_s_dragoons: our own Normann's dragoons; also called the dragoons
criteria.w9_frederick_s_artillery: our own Frederick's artillery; also called the artillery, the guns
